notes.title: Update 0.08 - Transport Missions, Earnings, New Map, New Truck
notes.notes:
[b]Main Changes[/b]

[list]
[*] Cargo transport missions.
[*] Earn money from the transport missions.
[*] Buying vehicles.
[*] Buying fuel.
[*] Navigation Map.
[*] Option to use Clutch.
[*] New Truck (Torq 6) with 2 versions (Dump Truck and Tanker Truck).
[*] New Map (The Hills).
[*] Added more roads on all the maps.
[/list]

[b]Gameplay Changes[/b]

[list]
[*] At the start of the game you will own just 1 truck and you will need to earn money to be able to buy more vehicles.
[*] On the Suspension Test Map you will be able to use any vehicle you want even if you don't own it.
[*] If the vehicle has less than 5 Galons of fuel it will get refueld for free in the garage up to 5 Galons of fuel.
[*] If you reset a loaded vehicle you will lose the load.
[/list]

notes.title: My Truck Game & Offroad Mania - BUNDLE
notes.notes:
ABOUT THIS BUNDLE

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/27811/Automobile_Sim_Bundle/

[h3]Automobile Sim Bundle includes:[/h3]

[u]Offroad Mania[/u] — based on realistic car physics for anyone who likes casual off road driving and tough challenges. Play different modes: Classic (240 levels), Free roam, Racing, Endless. Unlock 10+ amazing 4×4 off road cars for much driving fun. We update the game with free content regularly!

[u]My Truck Game [/u]— this game is focused on physics based off road truck and bus simulation. The main priority is tire deformation and suspension simulation for heavy vehicles.

[h3]My Truck Game Next Update[/h3]

At the moment work is being done on a game update which will bring transport missions to the game and an economy system.
You will be able to transport cargos to diferrent destinations and earn money which will be necessary in order to buy trucks and fuel.

notes.title: Tractor Coming Soon
notes.notes:
The next vehicle that will be added to the game will be a tractor. There are some things that need to be fixed and fine tuned, but the plan is to release it this week probably in the weekend.
In tractors the tires have a significant contribution to the suspension, some relying exclusively on the tires for suspension. 
Using soft body physics tires will help with achieving a simulation closer to the reality.
There are plans to add more tractors to the game in the near future.
